description: Audit a URL for CORS misconfigurations across several origins: wildcard with credentials, reflected origin, null origin, subdomain bypass, missing Vary. Returns risk level (safe/low/medium/high/critical) plus per-origin results. "unknown" means nothing was tested: every origin failed to connect, answered 5xx, or was refused with no CORS header (a 404, a firewall); never read it as "safe".

origin.description: Custom Origin header to test (default: tests multiple origins automatically)

name: cors_test
